WITH line_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    spent / CAST(amount AS REAL) AS line_ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount != 0
),
event_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(line_ratio) AS event_ratio
  FROM line_ratios
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_ratio) AS avg_event_ratio
  FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT 
  event_ratios.link_to_event,
  event_ratios.event_ratio,
  event_ratios.event_ratio / overall_avg.avg_event_ratio AS relative_ratio
FROM event_ratios
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
